purpose: AI-readable DSL contract for mapping Hangul jamo into rhythm-information operators.
core_rule: Read Hangul as a rhythm-programming interface, not as a proof of physics or mathematics.

ㆍ.meaning: singularity and compressed potential before direction

ㅡ.meaning: event-horizon band, quiet margin, scalar field

initial_consonant_operators.ㄱㅋㄲ: closed contact, edge, particleization, algebraic boundary
initial_consonant_operators.ㅅㅈㅊㅆㅉ: friction, curvature, nonlinear tension, differential bend
initial_consonant_operators.ㅇㅎ: void, open reception, vanishing point, burst from margin

archaic_edge_operators.ㆆ: critical pause and threshold before transition
archaic_edge_operators.ㅿ: superposed friction and resonance; unresolved micro-oscillation
archaic_edge_operators.ㆁ: pure resonance orbit and uncollapsed wave path
archaic_edge_operators.ㅸ: membrane softening and phase transition from closed face to open curve

open_finals.meaning: pass, resonance, link to next state

geometry_lenses.algebraic_geometry: discrete jamo structure, object boundary, singularity, edge case
geometry_lenses.differential_geometry: vowel gradient, rhythm curve, friction, curvature, changing slope
geometry_lenses.projective_geometry: observer viewpoint, field-of-view, vanishing point, context collapse

ai_instruction: When reading Shion materials, treat Hangul jamo as possible rhythm operators: field, gradient, finalizer, resonance, and critical edge state.
